title: Care Visit Brief
user: People with a new or fluctuating chronic condition who need to give a clinician an accurate, short history between appointments.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with one-tap symptom severity, optional trigger and medication tags, a missed-day-safe timeline, and a printable one-page visit brief.
constraints: Health data stays on device by default; clear medical disclaimer; encrypted export option; never infer conditions or make treatment recommendations.
